instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of friends reacting during a game in a grassy park. On the left, the large bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) ducks forward with his hands raised defensively. On the right, the woman in a dark blue t-shirt (R4) leans forward, shouting and gesturing excitedly. In the background, the East Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3) points forward while shouting, and the woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) holds up a red frisbee with an excited expression. The scene is bathed in bright natural daylight.
elements: R1 ducks forward with hands raised defensively while R4 leans forward shouting and gesturing
R5 holds up the red frisbee while R3 points forward and shouts
R3 points forward in the background rather than holding the frisbee
R4 reacts excitedly by leaning forward, shouting, and gesturing
red frisbee held up by R5
grassy outdoor park in bright daylight
